title: Contributing to pitchimpact
text: Fork package clone onto computer. haven’t done , recommend using usethis::create_from_github("ifylopez/pitchimpact", fork = TRUE). Install development dependencies devtools::install_dev_deps(), make sure package passes R CMD check running devtools::check(). R CMD check doesn’t pass cleanly, ’s good idea ask help continuing. Create Git branch pull request (PR). recommend using usethis::pr_init("brief-description--change"). Make changes, commit git, create PR running usethis::pr_push(), following prompts browser. title PR briefly describe change. body PR contain Fixes #issue-number. user-facing changes, add bullet top NEWS.md (.e. just first header). title: Merge FBref tables into a player-season master table — merge_fbref_tables
text: standard Tibble import_fbref_standard(). Recommended. shooting Tibble import_fbref_shooting(). Optional. passing Tibble import_fbref_passing(). Optional. defensive Tibble import_fbref_defensive_actions(). Optional. possession Tibble import_fbref_possession(). Optional. key Character vector join keys. Default: c("team","season","player"). strict TRUE, stops duplicated keys detected within input table.
